entities.summary: Kofi Setordji is a multidisciplinary visual artist based in Ghana. His works range from graphic design, textile designing, sculpture and painting. Kofi Setordji was a painters & sculptors from Accra (b. 1957-02-15, Accra). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
